links.outcome: Accuracy of AI-generated visual usage instructions for medications, including errors that could harm patients
links.effect: Visual output through GPT-4o generated images contained many errors that would hinder medication effectiveness or cause direct harm, scoring 1.5 ± 0.577 (16.7%), versus 3.55 ± 0.605 (85%) for written responses.
links.quote: In contrast, the visual output through GPT-4o generated images illustrating usage instructions contained many errors that would either hinder the effectiveness of the medication or cause direct harm to the patient with a poor score of 1.5 ± 0.577 (16.7%).

screen.reason: Evaluates GPT-4o's multimodal capabilities (image input to generate written and visual medication education) offline on 20 medication pictures, without testing a specific organizational deployment practice or guardrail.
